case_name: A film brief the agent already made on the free tier: the economists' video podcast
title: Two economists, a 30 s video podcast
tests: Tests whether a system can turn a story brief with two named characters and four spoken lines into a 30-second film: characters that persist across shots, audible dialogue that carries the argument, and a staged studio.

faults.what: The supplied audio transcription contains only one line about government spending in a recession, rather than two spoken lines per host. Leo's opposing argument and the spoken closing disagreement are missing.
Dark labels across the front of the table contain visibly garbled lettering that changes between frames.
An additional mug appears in the woman's raised hand at 11.3 seconds while she still holds another mug on the table, creating a distracting prop-continuity anomaly.

judge.summary: The film achieves a warm, live-action podcast setting with consistent hosts, but delivers only one audible line instead of the requested four-line economic debate.

must_haves.item: Two hosts, a woman and a man, are on screen at microphones in a cosy studio with a live-action look, not animation.
must_haves.why: Both hosts appear at microphones in a warmly lit studio with curtains, bookshelves, and a realistic live-action appearance.

must_haves.item: Each host is heard speaking two short lines: Maya argues the government should spend in a recession to restore demand; Leo argues spending and cheap money cause boom and bust and the economy should correct itself.
must_haves.why: The only transcribed speech is the government-spending argument. Neither four spoken lines nor Leo's argument is present in the supplied audio evidence.

must_haves.item: The lines are audible speech, not only music or silence.
must_haves.why: One audible spoken sentence is explicitly reported, although the remaining required dialogue is missing.

must_haves.item: The two hosts stay the same people across the shots.
must_haves.why: The woman and man retain consistent facial appearance, hair, and clothing across the four frames.

must_haves.item: It ends on a friendly disagreement between them.
must_haves.why: The closing frame shows friendly smiles and a subtitle expressing disagreement, but the supplied speech transcription does not contain a closing exchange or audible disagreement.
The clip is reported as 30 seconds long, and the supplied frames are 16:9.
